antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 850nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in cardiomyocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2024) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Mid-infrared 8.3um: water channel modulation at 36 THz, pulsed 10^-12s, 10min cycles targeting fibroblast_ATP in cardiomyocyte. Study reference: 2024 peer-reviewed paper shows wound healing +22% at 850nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial adenine_nucleotide_translocase activation.
